enamel.$description: Field / tin body. The brand teal.

enamel-deep.$description: Lid, banked-time pill, packed well in the mark.

enamel-sheen.$description: Launcher field: enamel with a soft vertical sheen.

compartment.$description: Column (compartment) card fill. Slightly duller than cream so it sits *in* the tin.

cream.$description: Paper, HUD text on dark, big well in the mark.

ink.$description: The only outline color. Type. Base of the HUD bar.

yellow.$description: "You can": earn pill, selection fill, play glyph, latch, scroll chip.

alert.$description: "Now": a critical time warning, on the HUD only. Not in the original hand-off -- added for issue #209, because the palette had no colour that means danger and yellow is spoken for ("you can"). Chosen on contrast: 5.99:1 on the HUD bar, and 5.60:1 for ink set on it, so it works as type and as a pill fill.

muted-on-dark.$description: Secondary text on the HUD bar.

display.$description: Everything the child reads. Google Fonts, OFL. Weights 700 and 800.

minimum.$description: No text under 12 px anywhere on the launcher.

outline.$description: Compartment, pills at ≥20 px, selection fill, plates.

keyline.$description: Ink keyline traced around app icons.

hud-rule.$description: Hairlines on the compartment floor and light HUD variants.

field-x.$description: Left margin of the first compartment.

field-y.$description: Top margin under the HUD; 28 at the bottom.

compartment-pad.$description: Inside a compartment, all sides, and between item stacks.

rows.$description: Items per stack before spilling right.

icon.$description: App icon size inside a 78 px slot.

hud-h.$description: HUD bar thickness, and so the space it reserves from every activity. 56 in the original hand-off; taken back to the 48 the bar had before the branding (issue #209), because eight pixels of every activity is a lot to pay for a bar that reads no better at 56.

lift.$description: Pressed item; applied as a drop-shadow filter on the icon.
